description: This file contains functions and type definitions for handling Feishu messages, including parsing message content, resolving group sessions, managing media resources, and handling mentions within the Feishu platform.

methods.name: resolveFeishuGroupSession
methods.description: Resolves the group session context based on chat ID, sender, message, and configuration options.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Parses message content based on message type, handling different formats like post, share_chat, and text.

methods.name: formatSubMessageContent
methods.description: Formats sub-message content based on its type, such as text, image, file, etc.

methods.name: parseMergeForwardContent
methods.description: Parses and summarizes merged and forwarded messages, extracting sub-messages.

methods.name: checkBotMentioned
methods.description: Checks if the bot is mentioned in a message, either via @ or mentions list.

methods.name: normalizeMentions
methods.description: Replaces mention keys in text with formatted mention tags or names.

methods.name: normalizeFeishuCommandProbeBody
methods.description: Cleans up command probe text by removing mentions and @ commands.

methods.name: parseMediaKeys
methods.description: Extracts media keys and filenames from message content based on message type.

methods.name: toMessageResourceType
methods.description: Converts message type to resource type ('image' or 'file').

methods.name: resolveFeishuMediaList
methods.description: Downloads and processes media resources embedded in messages, supporting images, files, audio, video, and post content.
